title: Efficient Multimodal Agents for Auditing 3D Worlds
title_zh: 用于审计 3D 世界的高效多模态智能体
abstract_en: Multimodal agents can now build interactive 3D worlds and games, yet these worlds, like those built by people, often contain glitches such as floating objects, walls that can be walked through, or objects that change when no one is looking. An automatic auditor could check such worlds at scale and provide rewards for agents that build them, but only if it is both accurate and cheap. Auditing requires three abilities, namely navigating to the objects that may contain a glitch, triggering glitches that appear only after a specific behavior, and recognizing what is wrong. Current auditors are either accurate but slow and expensive or cheap but unreliable. We study how much of the audit small models can take on. A 4B vision language model fine-tuned end to end on verified trajectories of a frontier teacher guided by Bayesian search learns to navigate and trigger, and six such explorers together match a frontier model on both, but recognition stays far behind. We therefore build an auditor in which a swarm of small explorers navigates and triggers, and a frontier model reviews what they record and report. On WorldAuditBench, our auditor succeeds on 55.9% of 213 tasks in Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js worlds, 13.6 points above the strongest auditor reported, at less than a quarter of its cost. It matches the frontier reviewer exploring on its own at 4.6 times lower cost and about half the latency. Without further training, it also answers embodied questions about real-world scans, matching the frontier reviewer exploring on its own and surpassing four other frontier models by 6.4 to 16.6 points.
abstract_zh: 多模态智能体已经能够构建交互式 3D 世界和游戏，但这些世界仍可能出现物体悬空、墙壁可穿越、物体在视线移开后发生变化等异常。要大规模检查这些世界，并为构建它们的智能体提供奖励信号，自动审计系统必须兼顾准确率与成本。审计需要三种能力：导航至可疑对象、通过特定行为触发异常，以及识别异常。研究发现，利用贝叶斯搜索引导的前沿教师模型生成经验证的轨迹，对一个 4B 视觉语言模型进行端到端微调后，六个小模型协同即可在导航和触发上达到前沿模型水平，但异常识别仍明显落后。为此，作者将探索与识别分工：小模型群负责导航和触发，前沿模型负责审阅其记录与报告。在 WorldAuditBench 上，该系统在 Unreal Engine 5 和 Three.js 世界中的 213 项任务上取得 55.9% 的成功率，比已报告的最强审计系统高 13.6 个百分点，成本不到其四分之一。与同一前沿模型独立探索相比，该系统表现相当，成本约为其 1/4.6，延迟约减半。无需额外训练，该系统还可回答基于真实世界扫描场景的具身问题，表现与同一前沿模型独立探索相当，并领先另外四个前沿模型 6.4 至 16.6 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 能力拆分：3D 审计并非只靠视觉识别，还需要主动导航，并执行特定行为以触发隐藏异常。
小模型的能力边界：六个经微调的 4B 探索智能体协作，在导航和触发上可匹敌前沿模型，但异常识别仍需由前沿模型负责。
审计效率：WorldAuditBench 成功率为 55.9%，较已报告的最强审计系统高 13.6 个百分点，成本不到其四分之一。
零额外训练迁移：在基于真实世界扫描场景的具身问答中，系统匹敌同一前沿模型独立探索的表现，并领先另外四个前沿模型 6.4 至 16.6 个百分点。
